Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the results from WebSurfer. The WebSurfer provided clear information that Anthemiolus was the son of Anthemius, who was the Western Roman Emperor. However, the Planner concluded that the origin of Anthemius was "Italy" based on the phrase "Anthemius of Italy." This interpretation is flawed because Anthemius was a ruler of the Western Roman Empire, which included Italy, but his personal origin was from the Eastern Roman Empire, specifically Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul, Turkey). The Planner failed to distinguish between the political domain of Anthemius (the Western Roman Empire) and his personal origin (the Eastern Roman Empire). This oversight led to the incorrect final answer of "Italy" instead of "Roman Empire."
